name: Everlast Minerals Ltd
summary: Everlast Minerals Ltd acquires, explores, develops and mines mineral sands projects in Bangladesh, looking for rutile, zircon, ilmenite, leucoxene, monazite, magnetite and garnet. Its flagship is the Gaibandha Mineral Sands project, with three mining leases by the Brahmaputra-Jamuna River in northern Bangladesh. It was incorporated in 2017 and has its head office in Sydney.
